$sources: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 18 (Seismic Design Requirements for Structures with Damping Systems): Sec 18.2 general requirements, Sec 18.6 damping system testing, Sec 18.7 alternate procedures (equivalent lateral force and response spectrum) and damping coefficients, Sec 18.5 design review

sources.general: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.2: the seismic force-resisting system and the damping system; the damping devices designed for the MCER response
sources.baseShear: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.7.1.2 (equivalent lateral force): V = sqrt(V1^2 + VR^2), not less than Vmin = V/B(V+I) or 0.75 V
sources.modal: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.7.1.2: W1 = (sum w phi)^2 / sum w phi^2, Gamma1, phi = h/hr permitted; residual mode TR = 0.4 T1
sources.coefficients: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.7.1.2: Cs1 = (R/Cd) SDS / (Omega0 B1D) (T1D < TS), (R/Cd) SD1 / (T1D Omega0 B1D) (T1D >= TS); CsR = (R/Cd) SDS / (Omega0 BR)
sources.displacement: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.7.3: D1D = (g / 4 pi^2) Gamma1 SDS T1D^2 / B1D or SD1 T1D / B1D
sources.effectiveDamping: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.7.4.2-18.7.4.5: beta1D = betaI + betaV1 sqrt(muD) + betaHD; betaHD = qH (0.64 - betaI)(1 - 1/muD), qH = 0.67 TS/T1 within 0.5-1.0; betaV = sum Wj / (4 pi W); muD = D1D/DY at most muMax
sources.dampingCoefficient: ASCE 7-22 Table 18.7-1: B by the effective damping, linear in between
sources.devices: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.2.2 and 18.7.4: the damping devices and their connections for the MCER displacements, velocities and forces
sources.requirements: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.2.4 (redundancy, inspection, testing), 18.6 (prototype and production tests)
sources.review: ASCE 7-22 Sec 18.5: design review of the damping system

ductility.note: muMax = R / (Omega0 Ie), the long-period limit; the short-period limit of Sec 18.7.4.4 is not applied (SAEngine practice, conservative for T1D below TS only where it limits muD less).

requirements.text: The seismic force-resisting system meets Chapter 12 for at least the minimum base shear Vmin
At least two damping devices at each storey in each principal direction, placed to resist torsion
Damping devices and their connections designed for the MCER displacements, velocities and forces
Inspection and periodic testing of the devices
Prototype tests and production tests of the damping devices

review: Preliminary design: the damping devices and the design criteria
Prototype testing of the damping devices
Final design of the structure with the damping system and the supporting analyses
The damping device production testing and inspection programme
note: Effective damping by the fundamental mode phi = h/hr (permitted for the equivalent lateral force procedure). The devices' design at 1.5 times the design-earthquake response stands for the MCER response (SAEngine practice for the ELF procedure; a nonlinear response history at the MCER gives them directly).
